Reference: 2019 landings. Independent all-taxon simple-chain estimate; all source support, all recorded labels and no group filter.
71 source groups; 522 catch taxa. No synthetic computational import group.
Simple-chain PPR totals 105,846,498.898 t C in 2019.
40 taxa lack a classic TL/coefficient; all have zero 2019 landings and contribute zero annual PPR. No positive-catch contribution is unknown.
Simple-chain PPR uses the fixed taxon coefficients of the simple trophic chain method.

Unresolved taxa: none. Very low approximations account for 10.1794% of landings and 3.7615% of simple-chain PPR. They concern broad mixed categories and absent-compartment analogues; exact taxa, assumptions and weights are flagged in the appendix.

Residual fish reporting uses bony-fish candidates; dedicated shark/ray pools are excluded. Mixed NC large pelagic retains Mola mola with cartilaginous pooling uncertainty. Complete source catch or biomass supplies assumed weights; model methods remain NOT_RUN.

The retained crustacean proxy includes documented decapods53–60, mixed nondecapod benthos61 and unspecified zooplankton65.
